721f60b8f7b47f6810f4845a722abb27d0d742f9.sourceText: Lambda 的优势在于：如果这个判断规则只在这里使用一次，就可以直接写在算法旁边，不需要额外定义一个函数或结构体。

7295708a2ed7572ba57032d9a112917638750f88.sourceText:
| 需求 | 推荐写法 | 说明 |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `double` 转 `int` | `static_cast<int>(x)` | 明确可能丢失小数 |
| `enum class` 转整数 | `static_cast<int>(e)` | 枚举类不会隐式转整数 |
| 基类指针转派生类指针，并且不确定真实类型 | `dynamic_cast<Derived*>(p)` | 转换失败可判断 `nullptr` |
| 去掉 `const` 适配旧接口 | `const_cast<T*>(p)` | 前提是旧接口不会修改真正的 const 对象 |
| 指针和整数互转、底层字节解释 | `reinterpret_cast<T>(x)` | 非常底层，优先避免 |
7295708a2ed7572ba57032d9a112917638750f88.translatedText:
| Requirement | Recommended写法 | Description |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `double` cast to `int` | `static_cast<int>(x)` | Explicitly acknowledges possible loss of fractional part |
| `enum class` cast to integer | `static_cast<int>(e)` | Enum classes are not implicitly converted to integers |
| Base class pointer to derived class pointer, and the actual type is uncertain | `dynamic_cast<Derived*>(p)` | Conversion failure can be checked with `nullptr` |
|  remove `const` adapt to legacy interface | `const_cast<T*>(p)` | Provided that the legacy interface does not modify the actual const object |
| Pointer\-to\-integer conversion and low\-level byte interpretation | `reinterpret_cast<T>(x)` | Very low\-level; avoid if possible |
